 Kings-Magic: First FG Scorer Odds & Picks – Nov. 10
 BetMGM 
 Nov 09, 2026, 1:22 PM 
 min read 
 Odds are available for the first field goal in the Kings-Magic game. Before tip-off at 7:10 pm on Tuesday, Nov. 10, at Golden 1 Center, check out odds for each player and statistical trends for the First FG Scorer markets at BetMGM.
 First Field Goal Scorer Trends
 Wendell Carter Jr. has attempted at least one field goal in the first minute in five of his last 10 games against the Kings.
 Franz Wagner has attempted at least one field goal in the first minute in four of his last eight games.
 Paolo Banchero has attempted at least one field goal in the first minute in 13 of his last 23 games.
 Opening Tip Stats & Trends
 Opening Tip Win Rate
 The Kings have won the opening tip-off in 50.0% of games this season – T14th in the NBA.
 The Magic have won the opening tip-off in 77.8% of games this season – 4th in the NBA.
 First Possession Conversion
 The Kings have scored on their opening possession in 30.0% of games this season – T23rd in the NBA.
 The Magic have scored on their opening possession in 44.4% of games this season – T13th in the NBA.
 Team’s First Field Goal Record
 The Kings have scored the game’s first field goal in 40.0% of games this season – T23rd in the NBA.
 The Magic have scored the game’s first field goal in 33.3% of games this season – T26th in the NBA.
